Yughues Free Sand Materials — Nobiax / Yughues
https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/2d/textures-materials/nature/yughues-free-sand-materials-12964
Only Sand11 albedo and normal maps are used on castle bodies and restoration
pieces. The separate YughuesCastleSand folder keeps this change independent of
the Sand01 ground PR. Flags, windows, shell inlays and the beach floor retain
their original materials. Object-aligned projection avoids missing mesh UVs.

Acquired 2026-11-09. Standard Unity Asset Store EULA:
https://unity.com/legal/as-terms
Original asset hashes and source paths are recorded in the imported package's
source.json. Source asset bytes are retained; Unity import settings and generated
rendering assets are adapted for Built-in rendering.
